purpose: Verify that an eligible permanent-purge request proceeds to permanent purge when the IT Head approves it.
preconditions: The archived data set has passed its retention period.
The Super Admin can complete authenticated destructive-action confirmation.
The IT Head is able to decide the pending purge request.
action_or_input: The Super Admin requests permanent purge and completes authenticated confirmation; the IT Head approves the request.
expected_result: The request enters Purge Request Pending IT Head Authorization, then the data set enters Permanently Purged.

purpose: Verify that an eligible permanent-purge request is rejected when the IT Head rejects it.
preconditions: The archived data set has passed its retention period.
The Super Admin can complete authenticated destructive-action confirmation.
The IT Head is able to decide the pending purge request.
action_or_input: The Super Admin requests permanent purge and completes authenticated confirmation; the IT Head rejects the request.
expected_result: The request enters Purge Request Pending IT Head Authorization, then Purge Request Rejected; the data remains archived.

purpose: Verify immediate activation and automatic expiry of a valid time-bound role.
preconditions: The target user is eligible for the role.
Role singularity and conflict checks pass.
The role requires an end date, and the assignment is not superseded by extension, reassignment, or revocation.
action_or_input: The Super Admin assigns the role with a start date effective immediately and a valid end date; advance to the applicable end date.
expected_result: The assignment becomes an Active Time-Bound Role immediately, then becomes Role Expired / Inactive at the end date.

purpose: Verify scheduled activation and automatic expiry of a future-dated time-bound role.
preconditions: The target user is eligible for the role.
Role singularity and conflict checks pass.
The role requires an end date, and the assignment remains valid and is not superseded by another lifecycle action.
action_or_input: The Super Admin assigns the role with a future start date and valid end date; advance first to the start date and then to the end date.
expected_result: The assignment is Scheduled Role Assignment, becomes Active Time-Bound Role on its start date, then becomes Role Expired / Inactive on its end date.

purpose: Verify one valid extension of an active time-bound role followed by expiry at the revised end date.
preconditions: The role is active and time-bound.
The current end date has not passed.
The new end date and reason are valid, and compatibility and singularity remain valid.
action_or_input: The Super Admin extends the role validity once before the current end date; advance to the revised end date.
expected_result: The role remains active with extended validity, then becomes Role Expired / Inactive at the revised end date.

purpose: Verify reactivation of a deactivated user who is not archived.
preconditions: The user is deactivated, is not archived, and reactivation is allowed by applicable policy.
action_or_input: The Super Admin selects Reactivate User for the account.
expected_result: The user transitions from Deactivated User to Active User.

purpose: Verify archival of an eligible deactivated user and restoration within the reversible period.
preconditions: The configured deactivation interval has elapsed.
No pending transaction blocks archival.
Required authorization for restoration is available.
action_or_input: The Super Admin archives the user with required critical confirmation; before the reversible period expires, the Super Admin restores the user with required authorization and authenticated confirmation where designated critical.
expected_result: The user transitions to Archived User – Reversible, then to User Restored from Archive.

source_id: BW-SA-08 / STT rows 1–2; Problem Statement §5, ISS-SA-004
purpose: Verify that an archived user's account becomes permanently non-restorable when the reversible period expires and that a later restoration attempt is rejected.
preconditions: The user is eligible for archival and required critical confirmation succeeds.
The configured reversible period expires without a completed restoration.
action_or_input: The Super Admin archives the user; advance beyond the reversible period, then attempt to restore the archived account.
expected_result: The user transitions from Archived User – Reversible to Archived User – Permanent / Non-Restorable; the restoration attempt is rejected and the account remains non-restorable.

purpose: Verify archival of eligible historical data and its later approved restoration.
preconditions: The historical data satisfies retention, completion, and dependency criteria.
Authenticated confirmation succeeds and backup is completed.
Required approval for restoration exists and restoration is allowed by policy.
action_or_input: The Super Admin archives the eligible historical data; later, the Super Admin restores it with required critical confirmation where applicable.
expected_result: The data transitions to Archived Historical Data, then to Historical Data Restored to Active System.
